description.value: Ruby Lake Resort is an Italian family-owned nature retreat set on an 88-acre bird sanctuary and natural reserve on the Sunshine Coast, operating since 1993. Guests choose from lagoon-view cottages, rainforest glamping tents, or rustic tiny wood cabins beside one of BC's warmest lakes, surrounded by forest, wetlands, and abundant wildlife. The on-site La Trattoria Italiana restaurant serves authentic north-Italian cuisine prepared with locally sourced, farm-to-table West Coast ingredients.

address.value: 15426 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Madeira Park BC V0N2H1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, operating 88-acre resort with cottages, glamping tents, and wood cabins on the Sunshine Coast, BC, Italian family-owned since 1993, with contact details (phone, address) consistent between OSM and the website. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched pages; glamping tents are described as having 'power, and lighting', indicating electrical access. The homepage contains injected Dutch-language pharmaceutical advertising text unrelated to the business, suggesting a possible website compromise.
concerns: Homepage contains injected Dutch-language pharmaceutical advertising text ('Zijn Viagra en Sildenafil hetzelfde?...'), suggesting a possible website compromise or spam injection — the underlying resort content appears legitimate.
Cottages subpage content is truncated mid-sentence at 'Perfect Wi', likely cutting off a Wi-Fi reference; Wi-Fi amenity could not be confirmed.
OSM record has no phone number listed; phone sourced from website only, so cross-check was not possible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible resort with multiple accommodation types and on-site dining; clearly operational and relevant to touring cyclists.
